2608.13438.title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
2608.13438.paper_summary: Contact-rich manipulation failures are often detected only after the robot has committed to contact. This is especially limiting in wrist-camera setups: close gripper--object views help observe contact, but a poor approach may already push, miss, slip, or disturb the object before conventional detectors react. We introduce \emph{ContactGuard}, a pre-contact execution monitor for chunked visuomotor policies. Given the policy's planned action chunk, ContactGuard predicts its short-horizon consequence in latent visual space and aborts if the predicted future latent indicates likely failure. Its latent world model is trained from unlabelled robot trajectories to predict compact multi-view visual embeddings under planned actions, avoiding pixel-level video prediction. A lightweight failure probe is then trained from a small labelled set of pre-contact clips. At deployment, ContactGuard anchors prediction before an imminent contact event, rolls the model forward under the policy's own actions, and verifies the predicted post-contact latent. Across real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ContactGuard predicts failure more accurately than direct and corrupted-action ablations, and transfers to live robot as a pre-contact abort signal without modifying the underlying policy.
2608.13438.paper_summary_zh: 接觸豐富的操作失敗通常只有在機器人已經進入接觸後才會被檢測到。這在手腕攝影機設置中尤其有限：緊密的夾持器-物體視角有助於觀察接觸，但不良的接近可能已經推動、錯過、滑動或擾動物體，這在傳統檢測器反應之前就已發生。我們介紹了\emph{ContactGuard}，一種針對分塊視覺運動策略的接觸前執行監控器。給定策略的計劃行動塊，ContactGuard預測其在潛在視覺空間中的短期後果，如果預測的未來潛在顯示可能失敗則中止。其潛在世界模型是從未標記的機器人軌跡中訓練出來的，以預測在計劃行動下的緊湊多視角視覺嵌入，避免像素級的視頻預測。然後，從一小組標記的接觸前片段中訓練出一個輕量級的失敗探測器。在部署時，ContactGuard在即將接觸事件之前固定預測，根據策略自己的行動向前推進模型，並驗證預測的接觸後潛在。在現實世界的接觸豐富操作任務中，ContactGuard比直接和損壞行動的消融實驗更準確地預測失敗，並作為接觸前中止信號轉移到實時機器人，而不修改底層策略。
